title: REPEAT Global Receipt Envelope
description: Minimal receipt envelope for REPEAT Global. All hashed artifacts MUST conform to the canonicalization rules in docs/CANONICALIZATION.md. receipt_hash = sha256_hex(canonical_json(receipt minus receipt_hash and signatures[*].sig)).

receipt_type.description: Identifies the semantic type of the receipt (e.g. 'registry_anchor', 'policy_update', 'seat_fill', 'council_attestation', 'revocation').

spec_version.description: Semver string identifying the REPEAT Global protocol version under which this receipt was produced.

registry_id.description: Identifier of the registry instance that recorded this receipt.

event_id.description: Globally unique identifier for the event that triggered this receipt. MUST be unique within the registry.

prev_receipt_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the immediately preceding receipt in the chain. Use the all-zeros sentinel ('0000...0000', 64 chars) for the genesis receipt.

payload_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the canonical payload artifact that this receipt covers.

policy_version.description: Version identifier of the policy contract that was enforced when this receipt was produced.

canonicalization_version.description: Version of the REPEAT Global canonicalization specification used when computing receipt_hash (e.g. '1.0.0').

actor.description: The entity responsible for producing this receipt.

actor_id.description: Stable, globally unique identifier for the actor within the registry.

event_time.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp (format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ) at which the event was recorded. Fractional seconds and timezone offsets are NOT permitted.

receipt_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of canonical_json(receipt minus receipt_hash and signatures[*].sig). This field MUST be excluded from its own hash projection (see docs/CANONICALIZATION.md). Derived field.

signatures.description: Ordered list of digital signatures over the receipt projection (receipt minus receipt_hash and signatures[*].sig). An empty array is schema-valid but produces a FAIL outcome during verification: at least one verified signature is required for PASS (see docs/VERIFICATION_OUTCOMES.md).

signer_id.description: Stable identifier of the signing entity within the registry.

sig.description: Lowercase hex-encoded signature bytes. This field is a derived field and MUST be excluded from the hash projection used to compute receipt_hash.

hashProjectionNote.description: Hash projection rule: receipt_hash = sha256_hex(canonical_json(receipt minus receipt_hash and signatures[*].sig)). Canonical JSON is defined in docs/CANONICALIZATION.md: UTF-8, NFC strings, lexicographically sorted keys, no insignificant whitespace, arrays in declared order, integers as JSON numbers, non-integers as quoted decimals, timestamps as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ, binary as lowercase hex.
